blocks.zh: 詞彙表 — 無菌製造關鍵術語雙語解析
blocks.en: Glossary: Key Terms in Sterile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 中所有官方術語的精確定義，避免在監管文件或審計中混用概念
blocks.en: Understand the precise definitions of all official terms in PIC/S Annex 1 (2022), so that concepts are not mixed up in regulatory documents or audits

blocks.zh: 理解每個關鍵術語（Grade A、CCS、RABS、Isolator、APS、PUPSIT、Bioburden 等）在無菌保證體系中的具體角色
blocks.en: Understand the specific role of each key term (Grade A, CCS, RABS, Isolator, APS, PUPSIT, Bioburden, etc.) within the sterility assurance system

blocks.zh: 區分易混淆的術語對：Action limit vs Alert level、Classified area vs Cleanroom、Corrective intervention vs Inherent intervention
blocks.en: Distinguish between easily confused pairs of terms: Action limit vs Alert level, Classified area vs Cleanroom, Corrective intervention vs Inherent intervention

blocks.zh: 建立術語間的系統連結，理解詞彙表如何支撐 Annex 1 各章節的邏輯架構
blocks.en: Build systematic links between terms, and understand how the glossary underpins the logical structure of the Annex 1 sections

blocks.zh: 如何使用本詞彙表
blocks.en: How to Use This Glossary

blocks.zh: 每個詞條左欄為原文英文定義（原文照錄），右欄為繁體中文譯名、詞條解釋及教學Commentary。標有 CRITICAL 的術語是 Annex 1 2022 年版的核心概念，考核或審計時最常被問及。標有 2022 NEW 的術語在舊版中定義較模糊，2022 年版有重大澄清。
blocks.en: In each entry, the left column gives the original English definition (reproduced verbatim), and the right column gives the Chinese term, an explanation of the entry and teaching commentary. Terms marked CRITICAL are core concepts of the 2022 version of Annex 1 and are the ones most often asked about in assessments or audits. Terms marked 2022 NEW were loosely defined in the previous version and were significantly clarified in the 2022 version.

blocks.zh: 氣閘 / 緩衝間
blocks.en: Airlock

blocks.zh: 連通不同潔淨等級房間之間的過渡空間，配有連鎖門（interlocked doors）確保兩側門不能同時打開，以維持壓差控制。
blocks.en: A transition space between rooms of different cleanliness grades, fitted with interlocked doors so that both doors cannot be open at the same time, in order to maintain pressure differential control.

blocks.zh: 關鍵設計原則：壓差方向必須從高潔淨度流向低潔淨度（正壓保護），確保污染物不能「逆流」進入高等級區域。氣閘是 CCS 實體屏障的基礎元素。
blocks.en: Key design principle: the pressure differential must run from the higher cleanliness grade to the lower one (positive pressure protection), so that contaminants cannot "flow back" into the higher-grade area. Airlocks are a fundamental element of the physical barriers in the CCS.

blocks.zh: 行動限度 (Action Limit)
blocks.en: Action Limit

blocks.zh: 一旦超過即須啟動調查與糾正行動 (CAPA) 的絕對限值。對應 Annex 1 表中的微生物與顆粒計數限度。
blocks.en: An absolute limit which, once exceeded, requires an investigation and corrective action (CAPA). It corresponds to the microbial and particle count limits in the Annex 1 tables.

blocks.zh: 與 Alert Level 的關係：Alert Level 是早期預警（超趨勢但未超限），Action Limit 是強制行動觸發點。違反 Action Limit 必須在批次放行前完成調查，否則 QP 不得簽署放行。
blocks.en: Relationship with Alert Level: an Alert Level is an early warning (a trend has been exceeded but not the limit), whereas an Action Limit is the mandatory trigger for action. An Action Limit excursion must be investigated before batch release, otherwise the QP may not certify the batch.

blocks.zh: 警示限度 (Alert Level)
blocks.en: Alert Level

blocks.zh: 早期警告訊號，提示製程可能偏離正常狀態，但尚未達到強制糾正行動的程度。需要調查與審查，但不一定導致批次拒絕。
blocks.en: An early warning signal that the process may be drifting from its normal state but has not yet reached the point requiring mandatory corrective action. It calls for investigation and review, but does not necessarily lead to batch rejection.

blocks.zh: Alert Level 是動態的（基於趨勢數據定期審查），不是靜態規格。一間運作良好的工廠，Alert Level 通常遠低於 Action Limit。若 Alert Level 頻繁被觸發，說明製程正在漂移，必須主動干預，而不是等到超過 Action Limit 才行動。
blocks.en: The Alert Level is dynamic (reviewed periodically based on trend data) and is not a static specification. In a well-run facility, Alert Levels are usually well below Action Limits. If Alert Levels are triggered frequently, the process is drifting and you must intervene proactively rather than wait until the Action Limit is exceeded.

blocks.zh: 無菌製程 (Aseptic Processing)
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing

blocks.zh: 在受控環境中處理已滅菌的產品、容器或設備，透過空氣、物料、人員的管控防止微生物、內毒素和顆粒汙染。
blocks.en: The handling of sterilised product, containers or equipment in a controlled environment, with control of air, materials and personnel to prevent contamination by microorganisms, endotoxins and particles.

blocks.zh: 無菌製程（Aseptic Processing）與終端滅菌（Terminal Sterilisation）的本質差異：無菌製程是「在整個過程中維持無菌狀態」，而終端滅菌是「製造後再殺菌」。當產品無法承受終端滅菌條件（如熱敏感生物製劑），無菌製程是唯一選擇，也是更高風險、更高監管要求的路徑。
blocks.en: The essential difference between aseptic processing and terminal sterilisation: aseptic processing means "maintaining sterility throughout the process", whereas terminal sterilisation means "sterilising after manufacture". When a product cannot withstand terminal sterilisation conditions (for example heat-sensitive biologics), aseptic processing is the only option, and it is the higher-risk path with higher regulatory expectations.

blocks.zh: 無菌製程模擬 (APS) / 培養基灌裝 (Media Fill)
blocks.en: Aseptic Process Simulation (APS) / Media Fill

blocks.zh: 模擬整個無菌製造製程，以培養基替代產品進行灌裝，驗證製程維持無菌的能力。俗稱「Media Fill」。
blocks.en: Simulating the entire aseptic manufacturing process, filling with culture medium in place of product, to demonstrate that the process can maintain sterility. Commonly known as "Media Fill".

blocks.zh: APS 是無菌製程最重要的定期驗證活動。Annex 1 要求每條生產線每半年至少執行一次，每批規模通常 ≥ 5,000 單位，合格標準：零生長（0 CFU）。APS 必須包含所有常規操作，包括人員干預——這正是為什麼干預管理是 APS 設計的核心挑戰。
blocks.en: APS is the most important periodic validation activity for aseptic processing. Annex 1 requires it at least twice a year for each filling line; the batch size is typically ≥ 5,000 units, and the acceptance criterion is zero growth (0 CFU). An APS must include all routine operations, including personnel interventions, which is why intervention management is the core challenge in APS design.

blocks.zh: 無菌狀態 (Asepsis)
blocks.en: Asepsis

blocks.zh: 透過無菌工作區域與操作行為共同達成的受控狀態，確保暴露的無菌產品不受微生物汙染。
blocks.en: A state of control attained by using an aseptic work area and performing activities in a manner that precludes microbiological contamination of the exposed sterile product.

blocks.zh: Asepsis 是一種「狀態」，不是一個「測試結果」。它是人員、環境、設備三者協調的結果，必須主動維持，而非被動確認。
blocks.en: Asepsis is a "state", not a "test result". It is the outcome of personnel, environment and equipment working together, and it must be actively maintained rather than passively confirmed.

blocks.zh: 細菌截留測試
blocks.en: Bacteria Retention Test

blocks.zh: 驗證過濾器能否有效截留細菌的測試，通常使用挑戰菌株
blocks.en: A test that verifies whether a filter can effectively retain bacteria, typically using the challenge organism

blocks.zh: （最小尺寸細菌之一），挑戰濃度 ≥ 10⁷ CFU/cm²。
blocks.en: (one of the smallest bacteria), at a challenge level of ≥ 10⁷ CFU/cm².

blocks.zh: 這是 sterilising grade filter（滅菌級過濾器）驗證的核心測試，也是 PUPSIT（使用前完整性測試）之外的另一道保障。過濾器驗證必須在與實際使用條件相符的條件下執行（相同壓差、流速、產品基質）。
blocks.en: This is the core test for validating a sterilising grade filter, and it is a safeguard in addition to PUPSIT (pre-use post-sterilisation integrity testing). Filter validation must be performed under conditions representative of actual use (same differential pressure, flow rate and product matrix).

blocks.zh: 屏障系統 (Barrier)
blocks.en: Barrier

blocks.zh: 將 Grade A 無菌處理區域與背景環境（Grade B 潔淨室）實體隔離的物理屏障，包括 RABS 和 Isolator 兩種主要技術形式。
blocks.en: A physical barrier that separates the Grade A aseptic processing area from the background environment (Grade B cleanroom). The two main technologies are RABS and isolators.

blocks.zh: 屏障技術是 Annex 1 2022 年版的核心推動方向。相較於傳統開放式 Grade A（僅靠層流保護），RABS 和 Isolator 大幅降低人員帶來的汙染風險，是現代無菌製造設施的標準配置。
blocks.en: Barrier technology is the core direction promoted by the 2022 version of Annex 1. Compared with a traditional open Grade A area (protected by unidirectional airflow alone), RABS and isolators greatly reduce the contamination risk from personnel and are the standard configuration of modern aseptic manufacturing facilities.

blocks.zh: 微生物負荷 (Bioburden)
blocks.en: Bioburden

blocks.zh: 特定物品上存在的微生物總量，包括人員、環境（空氣與表面）、設備、包材、原料、製程中物料或成品。
blocks.en: The population of viable microorganisms present on a specific item, including personnel, the environment (air and surfaces), equipment, packaging materials, raw materials, in-process materials or finished product.

blocks.zh: Bioburden 不是「汙染事件」，而是一個持續存在、需要管控的製程參數。在無菌製造中，bioburden 必須在滅菌步驟前維持在已驗證的限度內，否則滅菌效率的計算基礎將失效。Section 10 要求每批次都測定。Bioburden 測試取樣點應代表「最壞情況」（如 hold time 最末）。
blocks.en: Bioburden is not a "contamination event"; it is a permanently present process parameter that needs to be controlled. In sterile manufacturing, bioburden must be kept within validated limits before the sterilisation step, otherwise the basis for calculating sterilisation efficacy no longer holds. Section 10 requires it to be determined for every batch. Bioburden sampling points should represent the "worst case" (for example the end of the hold time).

blocks.zh: 生物去汙 (Bio-decontamination)
blocks.en: Bio-decontamination

blocks.zh: 使用殺孢子劑（sporicidal agent）消滅活性微生物負荷的製程。主要用於 Isolator 的定期內表面去汙（如 VHP 氣化過氧化氫處理）。
blocks.en: A process that eliminates viable bioburden by means of a sporicidal agent. It is mainly used for periodic decontamination of the internal surfaces of isolators (for example VHP, vaporised hydrogen peroxide treatment).

blocks.zh: Bio-decontamination 是 Isolator 技術的關鍵優勢：可定期執行徹底的殺孢子劑去汙，達到比傳統潔淨室消毒更高的微生物控制水平。每次 bio-decontamination cycle 必須驗證（log reduction 數據），並以 BI 確認效果。
blocks.en: Bio-decontamination is a key advantage of isolator technology: a thorough sporicidal decontamination can be performed regularly, achieving a higher level of microbial control than conventional cleanroom disinfection. Every bio-decontamination cycle must be validated (log reduction data) and its effect confirmed with BIs.

blocks.zh: 生物指示劑 (Biological Indicators, BI)
blocks.en: Biological Indicators (BI)

blocks.zh: 接種已知數量且對特定製程具有高度抵抗力的微生物，放置於滅菌器或去汙處理位置，用於驗證滅菌 / 去汙週期的效能。
blocks.en: Microorganisms inoculated at a known population and highly resistant to a specific process, placed in the sterilizer or at decontamination locations to verify the performance of the sterilisation / decontamination cycle.

blocks.zh: BI 的品質由三個參數定義：D-value（每個 BI 菌株的抵抗力指標）、初始菌落數（通常 ≥ 10⁶ CFU/BI）、純度。接收每批 BI 時必須驗證這三個參數，否則驗證結論無效。蒸汽滅菌常用 Geobacillus stearothermophilus，VHP 去汙常用 Bacillus atrophaeus。
blocks.en: BI quality is defined by three parameters: D-value (a measure of the resistance of each BI strain), initial population (typically ≥ 10⁶ CFU/BI) and purity. These three parameters must be verified on receipt of each BI lot, otherwise the validation conclusion is invalid. Geobacillus stearothermophilus is commonly used for steam sterilisation, and Bacillus atrophaeus for VHP decontamination.

blocks.zh: 吹製-充填-密封 (BFS)
blocks.en: Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS)

blocks.zh: 從熱塑性顆粒料直接成型容器、即時充填、即時密封的全自動一體化技術。兩種主要機型：梭式型（Shuttle，帶 Parison 切割）和旋轉型（Rotary，閉合 Parison）。
blocks.en: A fully automated, integrated technology that forms containers directly from thermoplastic granules, fills them immediately and seals them immediately. There are two main machine types: shuttle type (with parison cutting) and rotary type (closed parison).

blocks.zh: BFS 是終端滅菌產品（大容量注射液、眼科製劑）的主流技術，其「成型即充填即封口」的設計本質上最小化了環境暴露時間。Annex 1 2022 年版專章要求對 BFS 製程的關鍵區域（product nozzle 附近）進行 Grade A 保護。
blocks.en: BFS is the mainstream technology for terminally sterilised products (large-volume parenterals, ophthalmic preparations), and its "form, fill and seal in one operation" design inherently minimises environmental exposure time. The 2022 version of Annex 1 has a dedicated section requiring Grade A protection of the critical zone of the BFS process (around the product nozzle).

blocks.zh: 連續批次製造 (Campaign Manufacture)
blocks.en: Campaign Manufacture

blocks.zh: 在特定時期內連續製造相同產品的一系列批次，並嚴格遵守已建立及驗證的管控措施。
blocks.en: The continuous manufacture of a series of batches of the same product over a given period, with strict adherence to established and validated control measures.

blocks.zh: Campaign 製造允許在不清洗設備的情況下連續生產多批，前提是已驗證 campaign 期間不發生交叉汙染，並設定 campaign 最大持續時間（與微生物控制能力相關）。
blocks.en: Campaign manufacture allows multiple batches to be produced consecutively without cleaning the equipment, provided it has been validated that no cross-contamination occurs during the campaign and a maximum campaign duration (related to microbial control capability) has been set.

blocks.zh: 潔淨區 / 潔淨室分類術語群
blocks.en: Terms for Clean Areas and Cleanrooms

blocks.zh: Classified area（分級區域）：
blocks.en: Classified area:

blocks.zh: 包含多個潔淨室的整體區域。
blocks.en: An area comprising multiple cleanrooms.

blocks.zh: Clean area（潔淨區）：
blocks.en: Clean area:

blocks.zh: 具有明確顆粒和微生物潔淨標準的區域，通常由多個相連潔淨室組成。
blocks.en: An area with defined particulate and microbial cleanliness standards, usually made up of several connected cleanrooms.

blocks.zh: Cleanroom（潔淨室）：
blocks.en: Cleanroom:

blocks.zh: 專門設計、維護和管控的房間，符合特定空氣潔淨等級。
blocks.en: A room specifically designed, maintained and controlled to meet a specified air cleanliness grade.

blocks.zh: Classification（分類）：
blocks.en: Classification:

blocks.zh: 透過顆粒計數確認等級的技術活動（ISO 14644-1）。
blocks.en: The technical activity of confirming the grade by particle counting (ISO 14644-1).

blocks.zh: Qualification（鑑定）：
blocks.en: Qualification:

blocks.zh: 確認潔淨室符合預期用途的綜合評估（包括微生物、氣流模式等）。
blocks.en: A comprehensive assessment confirming that the cleanroom is fit for its intended use (including microbiological aspects, airflow patterns, etc.).

blocks.zh: 重要區分：Classification 是物理測試（顆粒計數），Qualification 是更廣泛的符合性評估。兩者都需要定期重做——Annex 1 要求 Grade A/B 每 6 個月 re-qualify，Grade C/D 每 12 個月。
blocks.en: Important distinction: classification is a physical test (particle counting), whereas qualification is a broader assessment of compliance. Both must be repeated periodically; Annex 1 requires Grade A/B to be re-qualified every 6 months and Grade C/D every 12 months.

blocks.zh: 密閉系統 (Closed System)
blocks.en: Closed System

blocks.zh: 產品不暴露於周圍環境的系統，例如透過管路連接的儲液桶或袋系統，在連接完成後整體滅菌。
blocks.en: A system in which the product is not exposed to the surrounding environment, for example reservoirs or bag systems connected by tubing and sterilised as a whole after the connections are made.

blocks.zh: 注意 Annex 1 明確聲明：「closed system」在本文件中不指 RABS 或 Isolator。這是為了避免與屏障技術的命名混淆。Closed system 的代表例子是一次性使用系統（Single-Use Systems, SUS）的袋與管路組合——連接後、充填前整體滅菌，在操作中不開啟。
blocks.en: Note that Annex 1 explicitly states that "closed system" in this document does not refer to a RABS or an isolator. This is to avoid confusion with the naming of barrier technologies. A typical example of a closed system is a single-use system (SUS) bag and tubing assembly, sterilised as a whole after connection and before filling, and not opened during operation.

blocks.zh: 菌落形成單位 (CFU)
blocks.en: Colony Forming Unit (CFU)

blocks.zh: 微生物學計量單位，一個可辨識的菌落計為一個 CFU，可源自一個或多個微生物細胞。
blocks.en: A microbiological unit of measurement in which one identifiable colony is counted as one CFU; it may originate from one or more microbial cells.

blocks.zh: CFU 不等於「細菌個數」——因為細菌可能以群聚形式存在，一個菌落可能由多個細胞長成。這是環境監測中數據的固有局限性，也是為什麼 EM 結果需要搭配趨勢分析而非孤立判斷。
blocks.en: A CFU is not the same as the "number of bacteria", because bacteria can exist in clusters and one colony may grow from several cells. This is an inherent limitation of environmental monitoring data, and is why EM results need to be assessed with trend analysis rather than in isolation.

blocks.zh: 污染控制策略 (CCS) — Annex 1 2022 年版核心新概念
blocks.en: Contamination Control Strategy (CCS): The Core New Concept of the 2022 Version of Annex 1

blocks.zh: 針對微生物、內毒素 / 熱原及顆粒的一套計畫性管控措施，基於產品與製程的深度理解，確保製程效能與產品品質。CCS 整合了物料、設施、設備、製程管控、成品規格及監測計畫。
blocks.en: A planned set of controls for microorganisms, endotoxin / pyrogen and particles, derived from current product and process understanding, that assures process performance and product quality. The CCS integrates controls for materials, facilities, equipment, process controls, finished product specifications and the monitoring programme.

blocks.zh: CCS 是 Annex 1 2022 年版最重要的新增概念，貫穿全文 Section 2 至 Section 10。它的邏輯是：不再只靠「測試」找問題，而是從設計端就系統性地防範汙染。一個完整的 CCS 文件應涵蓋：汙染源識別 → 控制措施 → 監測方法 → 回顧週期。CCS 是 PQS（製藥品質體系）的一部分，需要定期審查更新。
blocks.en: The CCS is the most important new concept in the 2022 version of Annex 1 and runs through Sections 2 to 10. Its logic is that problems are no longer found by "testing" alone, but contamination is prevented systematically from the design stage. A complete CCS document should cover: identification of contamination sources → control measures → monitoring methods → review cycle. The CCS is part of the PQS (pharmaceutical quality system) and must be reviewed and updated periodically.

blocks.zh: 糾正性干預 (Corrective Intervention)
blocks.en: Corrective Intervention

blocks.zh: 在無菌製程執行期間，為糾正或調整製程所進行的干預。不定期發生，例如清除卡件、處理洩漏、調整感測器、更換設備零件。
blocks.en: An intervention performed during aseptic processing to correct or adjust the process. It does not occur at regular intervals, for example clearing jams, dealing with leaks, adjusting sensors or replacing equipment parts.

blocks.zh: 與 Inherent intervention（固有干預）的關鍵區別：Corrective intervention 是非計畫性的，代表製程出現了意外狀況。Annex 1 強調：每次 corrective intervention 都必須記錄，並在 APS（培養基灌裝）中模擬，以評估其對無菌性的潛在影響。高頻率的 corrective interventions 是製程問題的信號。
blocks.en: The key difference from an inherent intervention: a corrective intervention is unplanned and indicates that something unexpected has occurred in the process. Annex 1 stresses that every corrective intervention must be recorded and simulated in the APS (media fill) to assess its potential impact on sterility. A high frequency of corrective interventions is a signal of process problems.

blocks.zh: 關鍵表面 (Critical Surfaces)
blocks.en: Critical Surfaces

blocks.zh: 可能與無菌產品、容器或密封件直接接觸或直接影響其狀態的表面，必須在製程開始前完成滅菌，並在整個製程中維持無菌狀態。
blocks.en: Surfaces that may come into direct contact with, or directly affect the state of, the sterile product, containers or closures. They must be sterilised before the process starts and kept sterile throughout the process.

blocks.zh: Critical surfaces 的識別是風險評估的一部分。充填針（filling needle）、容器內表面、密封件等都屬於 critical surfaces。任何 critical surface 的完整性被破壞（如出現裂縫或腐蝕），都需要立即停線評估。
blocks.en: Identifying critical surfaces is part of the risk assessment. Filling needles, the inner surfaces of containers and closures are all critical surfaces. If the integrity of any critical surface is compromised (for example cracks or corrosion), the line must be stopped immediately for evaluation.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區域 (Critical Zone)
blocks.en: Critical Zone

blocks.zh: 無菌製程區域中，產品與關鍵表面暴露於環境中的位置——通常指 Grade A 區域內最核心的位置，如充填針正下方、開口容器正上方。
blocks.en: The location within the aseptic processing area where the product and critical surfaces are exposed to the environment, usually the innermost position within the Grade A area, such as directly below the filling needle or directly above open containers.

blocks.zh: Critical zone 必須維持最嚴格的 Grade A 空氣品質，且是環境監測最密集的位置。「First air（初級空氣）」原則要求 HEPA 過濾後的清潔氣流直接到達 critical zone，不被任何障礙物阻斷。
blocks.en: The critical zone must maintain the strictest Grade A air quality and is the location with the most intensive environmental monitoring. The "first air" principle requires HEPA-filtered clean airflow to reach the critical zone directly, without being interrupted by any obstruction.

blocks.zh: 關鍵干預 (Critical Intervention)
blocks.en: Critical Intervention

blocks.zh: 任何進入 critical zone 的干預行為，無論是計畫性（inherent）還是非計畫性（corrective）。這是無菌製程中風險最高的操作類型。
blocks.en: Any intervention that enters the critical zone, whether planned (inherent) or unplanned (corrective). This is the highest-risk type of operation in aseptic processing.

blocks.zh: Critical intervention 是 APS 最難模擬的部分，也是 Annex 1 要求特別記錄的操作。每次 critical intervention 後，應考慮額外取樣。APS 必須納入最壞情況下的 critical interventions 模擬。
blocks.en: Critical interventions are the hardest part to simulate in an APS and are operations that Annex 1 requires to be specially recorded. Additional sampling should be considered after each critical intervention. The APS must include simulation of worst-case critical interventions.

blocks.zh: D值 (D-value / Decimal Reduction Value)
blocks.en: D-value (Decimal Reduction Value)

blocks.zh: 使微生物數量減少 90%（即 1 log₁₀ 下降）所需的滅菌條件量（時間或劑量）。
blocks.en: The amount of sterilisation conditions (time or dose) required to reduce the microbial population by 90% (that is, a 1 log₁₀ reduction).

blocks.zh: D-value 是滅菌科學的基礎參數。SAL 10⁻⁶ 的計算：若初始 bioburden 為 10⁶ CFU，需要 12 個 D-value（12 logs）的殺滅效果。D-value 越小，代表微生物對該滅菌條件越敏感。BI 的 D-value 必須高於目標病原菌，以確保驗證的保守性。
blocks.en: The D-value is a fundamental parameter of sterilisation science. SAL 10⁻⁶ calculation: if the initial bioburden is 10⁶ CFU, a kill of 12 D-values (12 logs) is required. The smaller the D-value, the more sensitive the microorganism is to the sterilisation conditions. The D-value of the BI must be higher than that of the target bioburden organisms, to ensure the validation is conservative.

blocks.zh: 死角管段 (Dead Leg)
blocks.en: Dead Leg

blocks.zh: 管路中流體不流通的靜止段，長度超過管道內徑的 3 倍。Dead leg 是微生物滋生的高風險區域。
blocks.en: A static section of piping in which fluid does not circulate, with a length exceeding 3 times the inner diameter of the pipe. A dead leg is a high-risk area for microbial growth.

blocks.zh: 在製藥管路設計中，死角管段是 CCS 必須識別並消除（或最小化）的設計缺陷。WFI 和緩衝液系統特別需要避免死角，因為靜止的流體在室溫下可在數小時內形成生物膜（biofilm）。設計原則：3D 規則（dead leg 長度 ≤ 3 倍管道內徑）。
blocks.en: In pharmaceutical piping design, dead legs are design flaws that the CCS must identify and eliminate (or minimise). WFI and buffer systems in particular must avoid dead legs, because stagnant fluid at room temperature can form biofilm within hours. Design principle: the 3D rule (dead leg length ≤ 3 times the inner pipe diameter).

blocks.zh: 去熱原 (Depyrogenation)
blocks.en: Depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 去除或滅活熱原物質（如內毒素）至規定最低量的製程，通常採用乾熱法（≥ 250°C / 30 分鐘）或強酸鹼清洗法。
blocks.en: A process that removes or inactivates pyrogenic substances (such as endotoxin) to a specified minimum level, usually by dry heat (≥ 250°C / 30 minutes) or by washing with strong acids or alkalis.

blocks.zh: 去熱原與滅菌是兩個不同的概念：滅菌殺死微生物，但死亡後的革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁碎片（LPS，脂多醣）仍具熱原活性。因此，玻璃容器和不銹鋼設備需要先去熱原再滅菌，或使用已通過去熱原驗證的流程。去熱原效果通常要求至少 3-log reduction（USP <1230>）。
blocks.en: Depyrogenation and sterilisation are two different concepts: sterilisation kills microorganisms, but the cell wall fragments of dead Gram-negative bacteria (LPS, lipopolysaccharide) remain pyrogenically active. Glass containers and stainless steel equipment therefore need to be depyrogenated before sterilisation, or processed using a validated depyrogenation process. Depyrogenation is usually expected to achieve at least a 3-log reduction (USP <1230>).

blocks.zh: 內毒素 (Endotoxin)
blocks.en: Endotoxin

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁中的脂多醣（LPS），即使菌體已死亡仍具強烈熱原活性，注射後可引起從發燒到死亡的嚴重反應。
blocks.en: Lipopolysaccharide (LPS) from the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria, which remains strongly pyrogenic even after the bacterial cells have died, and which can cause severe reactions ranging from fever to death after injection.

blocks.zh: 內毒素是無菌注射劑最危險的品質風險之一，因為標準滅菌無法消除它。控制策略：（1）原材料（包括水）的內毒素限度控制；（2）容器與設備的去熱原驗證；（3）製程中最小化革蘭氏陰性菌的 bioburden。最終成品的內毒素限度由 ICH Q6A / 各藥典規定，通常以「內毒素單位 EU/劑量」表示。
blocks.en: Endotoxin is one of the most dangerous quality risks for sterile injectables because standard sterilisation cannot eliminate it. Control strategy: (1) control of endotoxin limits in raw materials (including water); (2) depyrogenation validation of containers and equipment; (3) minimising Gram-negative bioburden during the process. Endotoxin limits for finished products are set by ICH Q6A / the pharmacopoeias, usually expressed in "endotoxin units, EU/dose".

blocks.zh: 可萃取物 / 可溶出物 (E&L)
blocks.en: Extractables / Leachables (E&L)

blocks.zh: Extractables（可萃取物）：
blocks.en: Extractables:

blocks.zh: 在極端條件下（強溶劑、高溫）從設備或容器表面遷移出的化學物質——代表潛在的最大風險邊界。
blocks.en: Chemical substances that migrate from the surface of equipment or containers under extreme conditions (strong solvents, high temperature), representing the potential maximum risk boundary.

blocks.zh: Leachables（可溶出物）：
blocks.en: Leachables:

blocks.zh: 在正常使用或儲存條件下，實際遷移到產品中的化學物質——是真正的安全風險評估對象。
blocks.en: Chemical substances that actually migrate into the product under normal use or storage conditions, which are the true subject of safety risk assessment.

blocks.zh: E&L 分析是一次性使用系統（SUS）和容器密封系統（CCS）評估的核心內容。Extractables 是 Leachables 的超集（極端條件 ≥ 正常條件）。監管要求（如 USP <661>、ICH Q3E）規定需對最終包裝系統進行 E&L 研究，確認遷移物不超過安全閾值（Permitted Daily Exposure, PDE）。
blocks.en: E&L analysis is a core part of the assessment of single-use systems (SUS) and container closure systems (CCS). Extractables are a superset of leachables (extreme conditions ≥ normal conditions). Regulatory requirements (such as USP <661> and ICH Q3E) require E&L studies on the final packaging system, to confirm that migrants do not exceed the safety threshold (Permitted Daily Exposure, PDE).

blocks.zh: 初級氣流 (First Air)
blocks.en: First Air

blocks.zh: 從 HEPA 過濾器出來後直接到達產品或關鍵表面、未被任何障礙物中斷的氣流。First air 在接觸產品之前不應被人員、設備或其他表面污染。
blocks.en: Air coming directly from the HEPA filter to the product or critical surfaces without being interrupted by any obstruction. First air should not be contaminated by personnel, equipment or other surfaces before it reaches the product.

blocks.zh: First air 原則是 Grade A 設計的核心。違反 first air：手臂橫越開口容器上方、設備伸入充填針正下方的氣流路徑——這些動作會將「第二手空氣」（可能攜帶顆粒或微生物的氣流）導向關鍵區域。APS 觀察員和操作員培訓都必須強調這一原則。
blocks.en: The first air principle is at the core of Grade A design. Violations of first air include an arm passing over an open container, or equipment reaching into the airflow path directly below the filling needle; these actions direct "second-hand air" (airflow that may carry particles or microorganisms) towards the critical zone. Both APS observer training and operator training must emphasise this principle.

blocks.zh: 過濾器完整性測試 (Filter Integrity Test)
blocks.en: Filter Integrity Test

blocks.zh: 確認過濾器在搬運、安裝或製程後仍保持截留性能、未受損壞的測試。主要方法：泡點測試 (Bubble Point Test)、擴散流測試 (Diffusive Flow Test)、壓力保持測試。
blocks.en: A test confirming that a filter still retains its retention performance and has not been damaged after handling, installation or processing. Main methods: Bubble Point Test, Diffusive Flow Test and pressure hold test.

blocks.zh: PUPSIT（使用前滅菌後完整性測試）是此概念的延伸——要求在使用前（即灌裝前）、滅菌後立即做完整性測試，確認滅菌過程本身沒有損傷過濾器。Annex 1 2022 年版強化了 PUPSIT 要求，是重大監管更新之一。
blocks.en: PUPSIT (pre-use post-sterilisation integrity testing) is an extension of this concept: it requires an integrity test before use (that is, before filling) and immediately after sterilisation, to confirm that the sterilisation process itself has not damaged the filter. The 2022 version of Annex 1 strengthened the PUPSIT requirement, which is one of its major regulatory updates.

blocks.zh: 成型-充填-密封 (FFS)
blocks.en: Form-Fill-Seal (FFS)

blocks.zh: 從捲材薄膜連續成型容器、同時充填並密封的自動化技術，主要用於終端滅菌產品（靜脈輸液袋、眼藥水）。
blocks.en: An automated technology that continuously forms containers from rolled film while filling and sealing them, mainly used for terminally sterilised products (IV infusion bags, eye drops).

blocks.zh: FFS 和 BFS 都屬於「先成型後充填」技術，不同之處在於材料（FFS 使用薄膜捲材，BFS 使用熱塑性顆粒料）。兩種技術都因為容器暴露時間極短而具有較低的汙染風險，但 Annex 1 仍要求充填區域達到適當的潔淨等級保護。
blocks.en: FFS and BFS are both "form first, then fill" technologies; the difference lies in the material (FFS uses rolled film, BFS uses thermoplastic granules). Both technologies carry a lower contamination risk because the containers are exposed for a very short time, but Annex 1 still requires the filling area to be protected to an appropriate cleanliness grade.

blocks.zh: 更衣資格鑑定 (Gowning Qualification)
blocks.en: Gowning Qualification

blocks.zh: 初始評估並定期複評個別操作人員正確穿戴完整無菌服裝能力的計畫。
blocks.en: A programme for the initial assessment, and periodic reassessment, of the ability of individual operators to correctly don the complete aseptic gowning.

blocks.zh: 人員是無菌製程最大的汙染源。Gowning qualification 不只是「通過一次考試」，而是持續性的能力確認計畫（Annex 1 建議：Grade A/B 操作人員每 6 個月重新評估一次，包括穿衣後的表面微生物採樣）。任何更衣技術不合格的人員必須立即停止進入高等級潔淨區，直到重新培訓並通過評估。
blocks.en: Personnel are the largest contamination source in aseptic processing. Gowning qualification is not just "passing an exam once"; it is an ongoing programme of confirming competence (Annex 1 recommends that Grade A/B operators be reassessed every 6 months, including surface microbial sampling after gowning). Any person who fails the gowning technique must immediately stop entering higher-grade cleanrooms until retrained and reassessed successfully.

blocks.zh: A 級供氣 (Grade A Air Supply) — 2022 新增概念
blocks.en: Grade A Air Supply: A New Concept in 2022

blocks.zh: 通過 Grade A 等級 HEPA 過濾器的潔淨空氣供應，但不要求連續顆粒監測或符合 Grade A 微生物限度。特定用於已加塞但尚未軋蓋的小瓶的保護。
blocks.en: A supply of clean air through Grade A HEPA filters, but without the requirement for continuous particle monitoring or compliance with the Grade A microbial limits. It is specifically used to protect stoppered but not yet capped vials.

blocks.zh: 這是 Annex 1 2022 年版新增的中間狀態概念，解決了一個實際問題：已加塞的小瓶在等待軋蓋期間，容器密封已建立，微生物風險大幅降低，不需要完整的 Grade A 監測要求。這一概念的引入降低了工廠的監測負擔，同時保持了合理的風險管控。
blocks.en: This is a new intermediate-state concept in the 2022 version of Annex 1 that solves a practical problem: while stoppered vials are waiting to be capped, the container seal is already established and the microbial risk is greatly reduced, so the full Grade A monitoring requirements are not needed. Introducing this concept reduces the monitoring burden on facilities while retaining reasonable risk control.

blocks.zh: 高效空氣粒子過濾器 (HEPA Filter)
blocks.en: HEPA Filter

blocks.zh: 依據相關國際標準（EN 1822 / IEST-RP-CC001）規格的高效空氣過濾器，對 0.3 µm 顆粒的截留效率 ≥ 99.97%（H13 等級）或 ≥ 99.995%（H14 等級）。
blocks.en: A high efficiency particulate air filter specified according to relevant international standards (EN 1822 / IEST-RP-CC001), with a retention efficiency for 0.3 µm particles of ≥ 99.97% (H13 class) or ≥ 99.995% (H14 class).

blocks.zh: Grade A 要求使用 H14 等級 HEPA（99.995% 效率），Grade B/C/D 通常使用 H13。HEPA 過濾器本身需要定期完整性測試（DOP/PAO 測試），確認無針孔或安裝洩漏。HEPA 更換是維護管理中的關鍵活動，需要在 change control 框架下執行。
blocks.en: Grade A requires H14 HEPA filters (99.995% efficiency), while Grade B/C/D typically use H13. The HEPA filters themselves need periodic integrity testing (DOP/PAO testing) to confirm there are no pinholes or installation leaks. HEPA filter replacement is a key maintenance activity and must be performed under a change control framework.

blocks.zh: 固有干預 (Inherent Interventions)
blocks.en: Inherent Interventions

blocks.zh: 製程 SOP 或工作指導書中規定的、執行無菌製程所必要的計畫性操作，如設備組裝、補充容器、環境採樣。
blocks.en: Planned operations specified in the process SOP or work instructions and necessary to carry out the aseptic process, such as equipment assembly, container replenishment and environmental sampling.

blocks.zh: Inherent interventions 是可預測的，因此必須納入 APS 模擬中執行，以驗證這些「必要的干預」不會破壞無菌性。與 corrective interventions 的關鍵差異：inherent 是計畫的、可訓練的、可被 APS 驗證的；corrective 是意外的，代表製程控制失效。
blocks.en: Inherent interventions are predictable, so they must be performed in the APS simulation to verify that these "necessary interventions" do not compromise sterility. Key difference from corrective interventions: inherent interventions are planned, trainable and can be validated by the APS; corrective interventions are unexpected and indicate a failure of process control.

blocks.zh: 隔離器 (Isolator)
blocks.en: Isolator

blocks.zh: 能夠執行可重複內部生物去汙的密閉工作環境，內部工作區達到 Grade A 條件，與外部環境（潔淨室空氣、人員）完全持續隔離。
blocks.en: An enclosed working environment capable of repeatable internal bio-decontamination, whose internal working area meets Grade A conditions and is continuously and completely separated from the external environment (cleanroom air, personnel).

blocks.zh:
Isolator vs RABS 的核心差異：
• Isolator：完全密閉，人員透過手套操作，可執行殺孢子劑 bio-decontamination，背景潔淨室可降至 Grade D 甚至 unclassified。
• RABS：有剛性圍板但非完全密閉，背景必須是 Grade B。
比喻：Isolator = 太空站（完全封閉，可以在太空中操作）；RABS = 手術室中的無菌操作台（比較精準但仍在同一大環境中）。
Annex 1 2022 年版明確鼓勵採用 Isolator 技術，視為最高等級的無菌保證措施。
blocks.en:
Core differences between an isolator and a RABS:
• Isolator: fully enclosed, operated by personnel through gloves, capable of sporicidal bio-decontamination, and the background cleanroom can be reduced to Grade D or even unclassified.
• RABS: has rigid walls but is not fully enclosed, and the background must be Grade B.
Analogy: Isolator = a space station (fully sealed, so you can work in space); RABS = a sterile workbench in an operating theatre (more precise, but still in the same larger environment).
The 2022 version of Annex 1 explicitly encourages the adoption of isolator technology, regarding it as the highest level of sterility assurance measure.

blocks.zh: 在地分離菌株 (Local Isolates)
blocks.en: Local Isolates

blocks.zh: 從工廠潔淨區環境監測、人員監測或無菌試驗陽性結果中分離出的、具代表性的現場微生物菌株。
blocks.en: Representative microbial strains isolated on site from cleanroom environmental monitoring, personnel monitoring or positive sterility test results at the facility.

blocks.zh: Local isolates 對培養基品質測試（growth promotion testing）的重要性在 Section 10.9 中明確要求。工廠必須建立自己的 local isolate 庫，定期更新（因微生物生態隨時間演變）。Local isolates 也用於驗證清潔消毒劑的有效性——如果消毒劑對你工廠實際存在的菌株無效，照舊使用的消毒方案就是無效的 CCS。
blocks.en: The importance of local isolates for media quality testing (growth promotion testing) is explicitly required in Section 10.9. The facility must build its own library of local isolates and update it regularly (because the microbial ecology changes over time). Local isolates are also used to verify the effectiveness of cleaning and disinfectant agents: if a disinfectant is ineffective against the strains actually present in your facility, continuing to use the same disinfection regimen means an ineffective CCS.

blocks.zh: 凍乾 (Lyophilization / Freeze-Drying)
blocks.en: Lyophilization / Freeze-Drying

blocks.zh: 透過昇華（sublimation）去除溶劑的物理化學乾燥製程，主要目的是提升產品穩定性，適用於熱敏感或水不穩定的生物製劑。
blocks.en: A physicochemical drying process that removes solvent by sublimation. Its main purpose is to improve product stability, and it is suitable for heat-sensitive or water-unstable biologics.

blocks.zh: 凍乾過程中，已灌裝的瓶子在 Grade A 下轉移進凍乾機，凍乾完成後在 Grade A 下加塞——這是整個無菌充填製程中時間最長、環境暴露最複雜的步驟。Annex 1 對凍乾機裝載/卸載的 Grade A 保護有嚴格要求，且 APS 必須模擬凍乾操作（通常使用可成長的培養基並在凍乾條件下處理）。
blocks.en: During lyophilization, filled vials are transferred into the freeze dryer under Grade A, and are stoppered under Grade A after freeze-drying is complete. This is the longest step, with the most complex environmental exposure, in the entire aseptic filling process. Annex 1 has strict requirements for Grade A protection during freeze dryer loading/unloading, and the APS must simulate lyophilization operations (usually using a growth-supporting medium processed under lyophilization conditions).

blocks.zh: 超殺滅菌 (Overkill Sterilisation)
blocks.en: Overkill Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 提供至少 12 log₁₀ 微生物殺滅能力（相對於 D-value ≥ 1 分鐘的微生物）的滅菌製程，即使 bioburden 為零也能達到 SAL 10⁻⁶。
blocks.en: A sterilisation process that provides at least a 12 log₁₀ reduction of microorganisms having a minimum D-value of 1 minute, so that SAL 10⁻⁶ is achieved even if the bioburden is zero.

blocks.zh: Overkill 的邏輯：因為 12-log 的殺滅能力遠超任何實際的 bioburden，所以不需要每批監測 bioburden（只需定期監測，見 Section 10.3）。這是一種「保守過量」的設計，犧牲了一些製程效率，換取更簡單的品質管控。適用於能承受較苛滅菌條件的產品（如玻璃容器、設備零件）。
blocks.en: The logic of overkill: because a 12-log kill capability far exceeds any realistic bioburden, bioburden does not need to be monitored for every batch (only periodically, see Section 10.3). This is a "conservative excess" design that sacrifices some process efficiency in exchange for simpler quality control. It applies to products that can withstand harsher sterilisation conditions (such as glass containers and equipment parts).

blocks.zh: 無菌充填後終端加熱處理 (PAT)
blocks.en: Post-Aseptic Processing Terminal Heat Treatment (PAT)

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填後額外施加的終端濕熱處理，已驗證可達 SAL 10⁻⁶ 但不滿足標準蒸汽滅菌（F₀ ≥ 8 分鐘）的完整要求，同時可能有助於滅活病毒。
blocks.en: An additional terminal moist heat treatment applied after aseptic filling, validated to achieve SAL 10⁻⁶ but not meeting the full requirements of standard steam sterilisation (F₀ ≥ 8 minutes), and which may also help inactivate viruses.

blocks.zh: 這是 Annex 1 2022 年版新增的混合方法：結合無菌充填的靈活性（適合熱敏感產品）和終端處理的額外安全保障（特別是病毒風險）。此方法需要完整的驗證，包括最壞情況的熱分佈研究和 SAL 計算，且不能用於代替充分的無菌充填製程設計。
blocks.en: This is a hybrid approach newly introduced in the 2022 version of Annex 1: it combines the flexibility of aseptic filling (suitable for heat-sensitive products) with the extra safety assurance of terminal treatment (especially for viral risk). The approach requires full validation, including worst-case heat distribution studies and SAL calculations, and cannot be used in place of an adequately designed aseptic filling process.

blocks.zh: 快速傳遞系統 / 口 (RTP)
blocks.en: Rapid Transfer System / Port (RTP)

blocks.zh: 用於將物品傳遞進入 RABS 或 Isolator 的系統，最大限度降低對 critical zone 的風險。典型設計：alpha/beta 雙接口系統（外接 beta 接口與設備上的 alpha 接口對接後，內部才能開啟）。
blocks.en: A system used to transfer items into a RABS or isolator that minimises the risk to the critical zone. Typical design: an alpha/beta double-door system (the outer beta door docks with the alpha port on the equipment, and only then can the inside be opened).

blocks.zh: RTP 是屏障技術（RABS/Isolator）的核心配件。其設計確保傳遞過程不打破隔離狀態——alpha/beta 系統的原理：兩個接口只能在對接後才能分別開啟，整個操作在物理上不存在「同時對外開口」的狀態，大幅降低傳遞過程的汙染風險。
blocks.en: The RTP is a core accessory of barrier technology (RABS/isolator). Its design ensures that the transfer does not break the isolation. Principle of the alpha/beta system: the two ports can only be opened after docking, so there is physically never a state of "simultaneous opening to the outside" during the whole operation, greatly reducing the contamination risk during transfer.

blocks.zh: 限制進入屏障系統 (RABS)
blocks.en: Restricted Access Barrier System (RABS)

blocks.zh: 提供 Grade A 空氣品質的剛性圍板系統，使用手套伸入操作，以殺孢子劑消毒內表面，透過 RTP 和整合式傳遞埠傳遞物料。圍板內部與外部潔淨室（Grade B）之間有物理隔離但非完全密閉。
blocks.en: A rigid-wall enclosure system providing Grade A air quality, operated by reaching in through gloves, with internal surfaces disinfected with sporicidal agents, and materials transferred through RTPs and integrated transfer ports. There is physical separation, but not complete enclosure, between the inside of the enclosure and the external cleanroom (Grade B).

blocks.zh:
主動 RABS (Active RABS) vs. 被動 RABS (Passive RABS)：
• Active RABS：有獨立的 HEPA 過濾和氣流系統，即使門打開也能維持正壓。
• Passive RABS：依靠背景潔淨室的 HEPA 氣流，自身無獨立過濾。
Annex 1 2022 年版對 RABS 的門開啟有嚴格限制——開門必須有 SOP 規定、記錄、並考慮干預性質及對 APS 的影響。RABS 的背景環境至少需要 Grade B（這是與 Isolator 的主要差異）。
blocks.en:
Active RABS vs. Passive RABS:
• Active RABS: has its own HEPA filtration and airflow system, and can maintain positive pressure even when the doors are open.
• Passive RABS: relies on the HEPA airflow of the background cleanroom and has no independent filtration of its own.
The 2022 version of Annex 1 places strict limits on opening RABS doors: door opening must be governed by an SOP, recorded, and take into account the nature of the intervention and its impact on the APS. The RABS background environment must be at least Grade B (this is the main difference from an isolator).

blocks.zh: 一次性使用系統 (Single-Use Systems, SUS)
blocks.en: Single-Use Systems (SUS)

blocks.zh: 以一次性使用的拋棄式組件（袋、過濾器、管路、連接件）替代傳統可重複使用不銹鋼設備的系統。
blocks.en: Systems that use single-use disposable components (bags, filters, tubing, connectors) in place of traditional reusable stainless steel equipment.

blocks.zh: SUS 的核心優勢：（1）消除批次間交叉汙染風險（無需 CIP/SIP 驗證）；（2）縮短換品時間（changeover）；（3）降低清潔驗證負擔。主要風險：E&L（可萃取物/可溶出物）、供應鏈斷裂、完整性缺陷（針孔洩漏）。Annex 1 2022 年版新增了 SUS 專節（Section 8.74-8.78），要求完整的 E&L 評估和完整性驗證計畫。
blocks.en: Core advantages of SUS: (1) eliminate the risk of batch-to-batch cross-contamination (no CIP/SIP validation needed); (2) shorten changeover time; (3) reduce the cleaning validation burden. Main risks: E&L (extractables/leachables), supply chain disruption and integrity defects (pinhole leaks). The 2022 version of Annex 1 added a dedicated section on SUS (Section 8.74-8.78), requiring a full E&L assessment and integrity validation programme.

blocks.zh: 無菌產品 (Sterile Product)
blocks.en: Sterile Product

blocks.zh: 在本文件範圍內，指在無菌條件下暴露並最終構成無菌活性物質或成品的所有已滅菌元素（包括容器、密封件、組件），或透過終端滅菌製程達到無菌的產品。
blocks.en: Within the scope of this document, all sterilised elements (including containers, closures and components) exposed under aseptic conditions that ultimately make up the sterile active substance or finished product, or a product rendered sterile by a terminal sterilisation process.

blocks.zh: 注意：Annex 1 的定義將「無菌」擴展到整個容器密封系統（container-closure system），不只是藥物本身。瓶子、橡膠塞、鋁蓋、注射器柱塞——所有接觸或包圍產品的元件都必須符合無菌要求。
blocks.en: Note that the Annex 1 definition extends "sterile" to the entire container-closure system, not just the drug itself. Vials, rubber stoppers, aluminium caps, syringe plungers: all components that contact or enclose the product must meet sterility requirements.

blocks.zh: 滅菌級過濾器 (Sterilising Grade Filter)
blocks.en: Sterilising Grade Filter

blocks.zh: 經過充分驗證、能從流體或氣體中去除定義的微生物挑戰並產生無菌流出物的過濾器，孔徑通常 ≤ 0.22 µm。
blocks.en: A filter that, when appropriately validated, removes a defined microbial challenge from a fluid or gas, producing a sterile effluent. The pore size is usually ≤ 0.22 µm.

blocks.zh: 「0.22 µm」是標稱孔徑，真正的過濾機制包括機械截留和靜電吸附。關鍵：過濾器必須針對特定產品基質進行驗證（因為某些有機溶劑、極端 pH 或高溫可能破壞過濾器的截留性能）。PUPSIT 確保使用前過濾器完整，使用後完整性測試確認製程中未損壞——兩者都是必要的，不可互相替代。
blocks.en: "0.22 µm" is the nominal pore size, and the actual filtration mechanisms include mechanical retention and electrostatic adsorption. Key point: the filter must be validated against the specific product matrix (because some organic solvents, extreme pH or high temperature may damage the filter's retention performance). PUPSIT ensures the filter is intact before use, and the post-use integrity test confirms it was not damaged during the process; both are necessary and neither can replace the other.

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌 (Terminal Sterilisation)
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 在最終容器中對產品施加致死性滅菌條件，達到預定的無菌保證水平 SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶（即每 100 萬支中最多允許 1 支存在活性微生物的理論概率）。
blocks.en: The application of a lethal sterilising agent or condition to a product in its final container to achieve a predetermined sterility assurance level (SAL) of ≤ 10⁻⁶ (that is, a theoretical probability of no more than 1 viable microorganism in 1 million units).

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌是無菌保證的「黃金標準」，因為整個製程最後一步進行滅菌，前面的汙染可以被彌補（在 bioburden 限度內）。Annex 1 明確要求：「只要產品性質允許，應優先選擇終端滅菌」。常見方法：蒸汽滅菌（最常用）、乾熱滅菌、輻射滅菌、環氧乙烷（EtO）。SAL 10⁻⁶ 的含義：100 萬支中最多 1 支不無菌的理論概率——注意，這是理論概率，不是允許 1 支不無菌的標準。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilisation is the "gold standard" of sterility assurance because sterilisation is the last step of the whole process, so earlier contamination can be compensated for (within bioburden limits). Annex 1 explicitly requires: "where the nature of the product permits, terminal sterilisation should be the preferred option". Common methods: steam sterilisation (most common), dry heat sterilisation, radiation sterilisation and ethylene oxide (EtO). Meaning of SAL 10⁻⁶: a theoretical probability of at most 1 non-sterile unit in 1 million; note that this is a theoretical probability, not a standard that permits 1 non-sterile unit.

blocks.zh: 紊流氣流 / 單向氣流 (UDAF)
blocks.en: Turbulent Airflow / Unidirectional Airflow (UDAF)

blocks.zh: 紊流氣流（Turbulent）：
blocks.en: Turbulent airflow:

blocks.zh: 非單向的混合氣流，以稀釋方式降低潔淨室顆粒濃度，適用於 Grade C/D。
blocks.en: Non-unidirectional mixed airflow that reduces the particle concentration in a cleanroom by dilution, suitable for Grade C/D.

blocks.zh: 單向氣流（Unidirectional）：
blocks.en: Unidirectional airflow:

blocks.zh: 方向一致、速度均勻、能持續將顆粒從關鍵區域掃走的氣流，Grade A/B 必須使用。
blocks.en: Airflow with a consistent direction and uniform velocity that continuously sweeps particles away from the critical zone, and must be used for Grade A/B.

blocks.zh: UDAF 單元：
blocks.en: UDAF unit:

blocks.zh: 提供過濾單向氣流的設備（即舊稱層流罩 LAF）。
blocks.en: Equipment that provides filtered unidirectional airflow (formerly known as a laminar air flow hood, LAF).

blocks.zh: 「層流」（Laminar Flow）在 Annex 1 2022 年版中已被「單向氣流（Unidirectional Airflow）」取代，因為真正的層流在製藥設施中很難實現。關鍵要求是「單一方向、均勻速度」，而非完美層流。Grade A 的典型單向氣流速度：0.36–0.54 m/s（垂直向下）。氣流速度需要驗證以確認能有效掃除顆粒，並且不會因設備干擾而產生渦流。
blocks.en: "Laminar flow" has been replaced by "unidirectional airflow" in the 2022 version of Annex 1, because true laminar flow is hard to achieve in pharmaceutical facilities. The key requirement is "a single direction and uniform velocity", not perfect laminar flow. Typical unidirectional airflow velocity for Grade A: 0.36–0.54 m/s (vertically downwards). Airflow velocity needs to be validated to confirm that it sweeps particles away effectively and does not create eddies because of equipment interference.

blocks.zh: 最壞情況 (Worst Case)
blocks.en: Worst Case

blocks.zh: 在正常製程操作範圍內，最有可能導致製程或產品失敗的條件組合，不一定真的導致失敗，但代表最大的風險暴露。
blocks.en: The combination of conditions, within the normal range of process operation, most likely to cause process or product failure. It does not necessarily lead to failure, but represents the greatest risk exposure.

blocks.zh: Worst case 是驗證設計的核心原則。例如：bioburden 取樣取 hold time 末期（最壞情況）；無菌試驗取批次最末充填的容器（最長暴露時間）；滅菌驗證使用最冷點/最慢加熱點的熱電偶（最低 SAL 位置）。如果最壞情況通過驗證，所有更好的條件都有合理信心。
blocks.en: Worst case is a core principle of validation design. Examples: bioburden sampling at the end of the hold time (worst case); sterility testing of the last containers filled in a batch (longest exposure time); sterilisation validation using the thermocouple at the cold spot / slowest-heating point (lowest SAL location). If the worst case passes validation, there is reasonable confidence in all better conditions.

blocks.zh: 水系統 (Water System)
blocks.en: Water System

blocks.zh: 生產、儲存和分配製藥用水的系統，通常符合藥典規格（如純化水 Purified Water 或注射用水 Water for Injection, WFI）。
blocks.en: A system for the production, storage and distribution of pharmaceutical water, usually complying with pharmacopoeial specifications (such as Purified Water or Water for Injection, WFI).

blocks.zh: WFI 是無菌製造中最常用的高規格水，對微生物（≤ 10 CFU/100 mL）、內毒素（≤ 0.25 EU/mL）、化學純度有嚴格要求。歐盟 GMP（包括 PIC/S）允許以膜過濾法（多效蒸餾 + RO/UF）製備 WFI，2017 年修訂後放寬了蒸餾的強制要求，但所有方法都必須達到相同的 WFI 規格。水系統是無菌工廠中最複雜的關鍵設施之一，dead leg 控制和持續循環是微生物管控的核心。
blocks.en: WFI is the high-specification water most commonly used in sterile manufacturing, with strict requirements for microorganisms (≤ 10 CFU/100 mL), endotoxin (≤ 0.25 EU/mL) and chemical purity. EU GMP (including PIC/S) allows WFI to be produced by membrane filtration (multi-effect distillation + RO/UF); the 2017 revision relaxed the mandatory requirement for distillation, but all methods must meet the same WFI specification. The water system is one of the most complex critical utilities in a sterile facility, and dead leg control and continuous circulation are the core of microbial control.

blocks.zh: Z值 (Z-value)
blocks.en: Z-value

blocks.zh: 導致 D-value 發生 10 倍變化（1 log₁₀）所需的溫度差異，用於描述微生物對溫度變化的敏感程度。
blocks.en: The temperature difference required to cause a 10-fold change (1 log₁₀) in the D-value, used to describe the sensitivity of a microorganism to changes in temperature.

blocks.zh: Z-value 是計算 F₀ 值（滅菌效力）的關鍵參數。蒸汽滅菌中，Geobacillus stearothermophilus 的 Z-value = 10°C。F₀ 計算：F₀ = ∫₀ᵗ 10^[(T-121)/Z] dt，積分了整個滅菌週期中所有溫度-時間組合的等效殺菌效果。F₀ ≥ 8 分鐘（歐洲標準）相當於 121°C 下的 8 分鐘滅菌等效效果。
blocks.en: The Z-value is a key parameter for calculating the F₀ value (sterilisation efficacy). In steam sterilisation, the Z-value of Geobacillus stearothermophilus = 10°C. F₀ calculation: F₀ = ∫₀ᵗ 10^[(T-121)/Z] dt, which integrates the equivalent lethal effect of all temperature-time combinations across the whole sterilisation cycle. F₀ ≥ 8 minutes (European standard) is equivalent to the lethality of 8 minutes of sterilisation at 121°C.

blocks.zh: 快速參考：關鍵術語對照表
blocks.en: Quick Reference: Key Terms Table

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Glossary Summary
blocks.en: Section Review: Glossary Summary

blocks.zh: CCS（污染控制策略）是 Annex 1 2022 年版的靈魂：所有管控措施必須整合為一個系統性的計畫，而非零散的測試和規格
blocks.en: CCS (contamination control strategy) is the soul of the 2022 version of Annex 1: all control measures must be integrated into one systematic plan, rather than scattered tests and specifications

blocks.zh: 屏障技術層次：Isolator（完全密閉）> Active RABS（獨立氣流）> Passive RABS（依賴背景）> 傳統開放式 Grade A；Annex 1 鼓勵優先採用更高等級的屏障技術
blocks.en: Hierarchy of barrier technologies: Isolator (fully enclosed) > Active RABS (independent airflow) > Passive RABS (relies on background) > traditional open Grade A; Annex 1 encourages preferring the higher-level barrier technologies

blocks.zh: Alert vs Action：Alert Level 是「早期預警，啟動調查」；Action Limit 是「強制 CAPA，影響批次放行決策」——兩者都必須有書面程序
blocks.en: Alert vs Action: an Alert Level is an "early warning that triggers investigation"; an Action Limit is a "mandatory CAPA that affects the batch release decision"; both must have a written procedure

blocks.zh: First Air + Critical Zone：Grade A 的物理保護邏輯——HEPA 氣流必須直接、未受干擾地到達產品暴露點；任何干預都是對這一保護的挑戰
blocks.en: First Air + Critical Zone: the physical protection logic of Grade A: HEPA airflow must reach the product exposure point directly and undisturbed; any intervention is a challenge to this protection

blocks.zh: SAL、D-value、Z-value、F₀形成滅菌科學的定量框架：Bioburden（初始負荷）× 製程效力（D-value × cycles）= 最終 SAL；這是終端滅菌驗證的數學基礎
blocks.en: SAL, D-value, Z-value, F₀ form the quantitative framework of sterilisation science: bioburden (initial load) × process efficacy (D-value × cycles) = final SAL; this is the mathematical basis of terminal sterilisation validation

blocks.zh: SUS 和 E&L：一次性使用系統的優勢（無交叉汙染、快速換品）以 E&L 評估作為前提條件，供應商 CoC 不能替代用戶自己的相容性評估
blocks.en: SUS and E&L: the advantages of single-use systems (no cross-contamination, fast changeover) are conditional on an E&L assessment; the supplier CoC cannot replace the user's own compatibility assessment
